summary: The calls and operations match, but the object offset is unnamed and signed addition can diverge.
issues: The member at self +0x0C is accessed by a raw offset rather than a named member.
value + 0x20 has undefined behavior in C++ if the signed value overflows; the binary performs a 32-bit addition.
fix_instructions: Define an offset-preserving member such as field_0C and access it by name.
Perform the addition as 32-bit unsigned arithmetic to preserve wraparound.
